parsed.reason: This does what a waitlist_final asks. It ties the clock to the parent's own message ('counted from when you told me you were waitlisted') and tells them to check email and the portal. Every handed fact is right: two hours left, Springfield, and 11:00 p.m. called 'tonight', which is correct against 9:00 p.m. the same day. It asks nothing, names no child and invents no claim. It reads like a natural English text. Calling the 36-hour response window an 'offer window' is a reasonable plain restatement, and leaving out the 36-hour figure is fine.
